comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C1, C4, C5, C13 regarding conservation and loss patterns across 180 species. Both evaluations find these claims strongly supported by the systematic phylogenetic analysis.

Perfect agreement on claims C6, C126, C127, C129 regarding the tight evolutionary coupling between CDCA7, HELLS, and DNMT1. Both evaluations confirm the presence/absence correlation patterns are well-supported.
